claim: For the March 2026 municipales, French media (LCP) published city-specific election-night estimates for at least 16 individual cities (Paris, Marseille, Lyon, Toulouse, Bordeaux, Strasbourg, Lille, Nice, Toulon, Montpellier, Rennes, Nantes, Besançon, Calais, Perpignan, Bastia), produced by Ipsos-Bva jointly with the CESI engineering school.
stance_target: French pollsters do publish sub-national, city-level election-night estimates for large individual cities, not just a single national figure
scope_conditions: March 2026 French municipal elections, first round
quoted_support: LCP publie les estimations de vote, réalisées par l'institut IPSOS Bva et CESI-école d'ingénieurs, dans plusieurs villes de France.

claim: City-level election-night estimation for the 2026 municipales was co-produced by a pollster (Ipsos-Bva) and an engineering school (CESI), an institutional pairing distinct from the pollster+media consortium model (Ipsos/Harris/Ifop + broadcaster) used for national legislative/presidential estimates.
quoted_support: les estimations de vote, réalisées par l'institut IPSOS Bva et CESI-école d'ingénieurs

claim: Published city-level municipal estimates for 2026 give only candidate-list vote shares (not seat/council composition), and the LCP results article discloses no methodology detail — no bureau count, no sample size — for how the city-level figures were derived, unlike the 1998 Ipsos regional/departmental piece.
stance_target: opacity of methodology disclosure for city-level estimates versus historical regional/departmental estimates
quoted_support: Découvrez les premières estimations du premier tour des élections municipales, réalisées par l'institut IPSOS et CESI-école d'ingénieurs, dans plusieurs villes de France.
